A steady week. You slept **7h 18m** a night on average, about 10 minutes more than the week before, and your resting heart rate held near 52 bpm.

Steps averaged 9,400 with your goal met on 4 days. Recovery dipped midweek after two late workouts, then came back by Saturday.

**One idea:** try finishing workouts a little earlier on weeknights and see whether your mornings feel easier.
